implementation: Immutable checksummed schema receipts; explicit maintenance adoption of unversioned installations; current-schema read-only/no-DDL fast path; shared session admission before database snapshots and exclusive transaction migration gate; runtime/worker/owner version, policy and effective role safety checks; maintenance 503 without credential disposal; CLI plan and browser retry.
new_schema_test_scope: Nine top-level real PostgreSQL store/server tests, including 12 receipt/function/RLS drift cases, six runtime-role drift cases, cancellation, backend termination, concurrent migrators, queue fairness/drain, future-version rejection, missing ledger, frozen step definitions, private receipt denial and an actual streamed OCI upload across three no-op migrations.
process_interruption_scope: Retained clean legacy source 51a74bd initializes and publishes real npm bytes. With its registry/worker stopped, an owned database event-trigger barrier pauses new CLI adoption after DDL. Actual SIGKILL, barrier release and backend disconnect leave no receipt or new function; retry preserves canonical tenant/repository/artifact/event/token rows and native npm installation. This is controlled adoption, not rolling upgrade.
limits: Legacy adoption requires all old binaries stopped; they do not participate in admission.
The gate covers each database transaction, not an entire transfer. Actual schema changes can interrupt a staged transfer at its next fenced callback; whole-transfer draining is unqualified.
The synthetic future-version fixture validates admission, atomic DDL and rejection of unknown schema, not a shipped version-3 feature or expand/contract compatibility.
Production rolling/online upgrade, compatible-version ranges, multi-host/HA, downgrade, backup/restore and scale/performance remain open.
Linux amd64/arm64 server and Windows amd64 CLI compile only. Native platform runtimes and Windows ACL semantics remain unqualified.
Four Chromium tests and 19 named automated states do not establish complete WCAG, assistive-technology or native-browser coverage.
All 450 broad capabilities/journeys and 41 format families remain unfinished; full product/security/packaging qualification remains required.
